results.name: Full runtime contains 32 relics, 20 pedestals, 25 unique NPCs and four additional boss encounters
Burst levels award exactly 2 stat / 1 skill points; no talent or mastery API remains
Save repeated 20 times preserves every derived stat, training, allocations and currency
Migration refunds spent mastery points and validates malformed RPG input
Normal, skill and summon damage use separate coefficients; boss and armor penetration apply
AS, movement, dash cooldown, crit, projectile speed, range, regen and CDR are consumed
Omnivamp, kill healing, defense flat block, thorns, tenacity and gold find affect gameplay
Stat reset charges exactly 80 at village and clamps HP/MP without inflation
Boss relic follows parabola, lands, persists and requires F; paused/dead cannot claim
All twelve named Boss sources produce exactly their own unowned drop
Pedestals reject guards and wrong elements, tools solve seal, claimed state persists
Kim Quy, Cuoi, Thach San, Thuy Tinh, Wukong and Phoenix use requested timers and effects
An Tiem drops consumable every six kills; Aladdin spends 80, returns 30; cooling is 22%
Split adds one 85% projectile, Pierce adds three and grows after hits
Giong triggers fourth attack, Mjolnir fifth, Aegis break stuns, fate thread lasts four seconds
DOM buffs real shadow units, elemental clones and summons without scaling twice
Summon HP and lifetime survive ten saves and live DOM changes without inflation
Phoenix aura ticks damage and charmed contact enemies cannot attack
Golems and treants survive repeated JSON saves with exact HP, duration and DOM
Third-hit relic snapshots attack number while bullets are in flight
Cuoi ignores a shielded hit and prevents actual lethal damage after armor
Truth layer four requires final saga, gate waits for returning village memories
Five hero stories complete through actual NPC / memory / melody / battle interactions
Three seeds keep every core NPC, pedestal and puzzle tool on reachable walkable cells
